dialogues.speaker: Katheryne
dialogues.text: Ad astra abyssosque! Welcome, Adventurer. I've been waiting for your arrival.

response.speaker: Katheryne
response.text: Thank you for your concern, I'm fine. However, the Guild is facing yet another emergency...

response.speaker: Katheryne
response.text: In the past few days, the Adventurers' Guild has received many eyewitness reports of Geovishaps.

response.speaker: Katheryne
response.text: Up till recently, the only known Geovishap sightings were those recorded in ancient texts. No one knows why they are suddenly making an appearance now.

response.speaker: Katheryne
response.text: They look quite similar to Geovishap Hatchlings, but they are very aggressive and possess far more destructive power.

response.speaker: Katheryne
response.text: During this time, many people are heading out to remote locations to sight-see and release lanterns. If they were to run into a Geovishap, the consequences would be dire indeed.

response.speaker: Katheryne
response.text: Unfortunately for us, many adventurers have now gone to see their families and friends. As such, we're currently experiencing a severe shortage of staff.

choices.text: Have you tried asking the Millelith?

response.speaker: Katheryne
response.text: They're facing the same situation as we are. Keeping the peace is a duty of equal importance to them, after all.

response.speaker: Katheryne
response.text: Considering your excellent performance recently, I feel that you are the only sensible choice for solving this particular issue.

choices.text: Fair enough, since it's an emergency.

response.speaker: Katheryne
response.text: Thank you for agreeing to help. First, we need you to follow the trail of the Geovishaps and ascertain their whereabouts.

response.speaker: Katheryne
response.text: I'm sure that you're familiar with the Guild's expedition system. I have organized the leads we have regarding the Geovishaps into a similar format.

response.speaker: Katheryne
response.text: Time is against us, so let's have a look.

response.speaker: Katheryne
response.text: The key difference between these expeditions and the normal ones is that the Guild has already conducted some preliminary investigations. If we act on the information we've already gathered, we should be able to dramatically improve the efficiency of our work.

response.speaker: Katheryne
response.text: The Guild will rank these expeditions based on the time required and the amount of risk involved. The higher the level, the greater the rewards.

response.speaker: Katheryne
response.text: If we amass the intelligence gathered from these leads, I am confident that we will be able to pinpoint the whereabouts of the Geovishaps.

choices.text: Then we take them out, I presume.

response.speaker: Katheryne
response.text: Indeed. Ah, and one other thing — we will update the available intelligence daily. In the meantime, I will do all that I can to support you and your friends as you investigate.

response.speaker: Katheryne
response.text: On that note, I shall leave the Geovishap investigation to you. Good luck. Ad astra abyssosque!

choices.text: What do you need me to do?
Can we call for reinforcements from other Guild branches?

response.speaker: Katheryne
response.text: Unfortunately, the situation in other branches is... somewhat complicated. We've received some backup, but it is far from enough.

response.speaker: Katheryne
response.text: Indeed, and it is an emergency.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: <color=#FFCC33FF>Have you any awesome commissions for me?</color>

dialogues.speaker: Katheryne
dialogues.text: You've come at just the right time. I have a handbook that the Guild would like to present to veteran adventurers such as yourself.

choices.text: Could it be the Official Teyvat Cookbook?

response.speaker: Katheryne
response.text: Unfortunately, it isn't.

response.speaker: Katheryne
response.text: As you can see, this handbook contains information on powerful enemies worth facing.

response.speaker: Katheryne
response.text: If you can make good use of it, I'm sure it will be a great help in your adventures. Of course, you're welcome to come back anytime if you need to check on any relevant information.

response.speaker: Katheryne
response.text: I wish you success in your endeavors!

response.speaker: Katheryne
response.text: It's up to you whether you wish to take on the challenge.

dialogues.speaker: Katheryne
dialogues.text: Adventurer, thanks to your hard work, the Geovishap investigation can be brought to a close.

response.speaker: Katheryne
response.text: Thank you for alleviating the pressure on the Guild.

response.speaker: Katheryne
response.text: All the adventurers who took leave to visit their families have now returned and reported in at the Guild. You have already made a great contribution, so please, leave the remaining work to us.

response.speaker: Katheryne
response.text: As for why these ancient creatures suddenly began appearing, we will continue to investigate.

response.speaker: Katheryne
response.text: Oh, and don't forget to claim your investigation rewards.

response.speaker: Katheryne
response.text: The Adventurers' Guild looks forward to your continued excellence! Ad astra abyssosque!

choices.text: Aw, I was just getting started.

response.speaker: Katheryne
response.text: Haha, it seems like you enjoyed yourself, then. That's wonderful.

dialogues.speaker: Katheryne
dialogues.text: I am sorry, but you have not yet completed enough commissions.

dialogues.speaker: Katheryne
dialogues.text: Thank you for completing today's commissions. Here is your reward.

dialogues.speaker: Katheryne
dialogues.text: <color=#999999FF>Claim Daily Commission Reward</color>

dialogues.speaker: Katheryne
dialogues.text: You have already claimed today's reward. Please come back for more commissions tomorrow!

dialogues.text: Dispatch Character on Expedition

dialogues.speaker: Katheryne

dialogues.speaker: Katheryne
dialogues.text: Ad astra abyssosque! Welcome to the Adventurers' Guild.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: ...Katheryne?

dialogues.speaker: Katheryne
dialogues.text: That's right. I am Katheryne, the receptionist here at the Adventurers' Guild.

dialogues.speaker: Katheryne
dialogues.text: It's my job to assign quests to our adventurers and provide intelligence support. Our service is all year round.

dialogues.speaker: Katheryne
dialogues.text: Is there something wrong, Adventurer? You seem... surprised?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: ...What are you doing here?

dialogues.speaker: Katheryne
dialogues.text: I'm sorry, I don't quite understand your confusion?

dialogues.speaker: Katheryne
dialogues.text: All Guild members should be well aware that Katheryne is the receptionist of the Adventurers' Guild. The Liyue branch can't go without a receptionist, can it?

dialogues.speaker: Katheryne
dialogues.text: Therefore, Katheryne is here.

dialogues.speaker: Katheryne
dialogues.text: ...Do you have any further questions?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Goodbye.

dialogues.speaker: Katheryne
dialogues.text: Farewell, Adventurer, and thank you for supporting the Adventurers' Guild.

dialogues.speaker: Katheryne
dialogues.text: Welcome to the Adventurers' Guild, My Lady. Is there something I can help you with?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Goodbye.

dialogues.speaker: Katheryne
dialogues.text: Farewell, My Lady, and thank you for supporting the Adventurers' Guild.
